notes.title: SERVER HOTFIX
notes.notes:
Credit rewards have been updated. The good news is older accounts can earn the same credit amounts as new players just by completing their gold-checked quests again. First time you repeat you'll get 10, then 20, then 30, even if they're already checked gold!! Same goes for completing heroic quests you've already beaten.

HOTFIX CHANGES

Repeated quest credit reward increased from 1 to 5.
Completing a quest cooperatively with another player will grant 10 bonus credits per quest.
Credit rewards are now shared per account. You may not be rewarded for the same bronze/silver/gold quest for multiple nations on your account. Repeated bronze/silver/gold quests on different nations will result in the normal repeat amount of 5 credits.
Quests will only reward credits if the quest has "Satisfied the Gods". This is our algorithm to detect whether you actually played the quest. The same check used for PvP battles.

notes.title: Patch 1.51 Is Live!
notes.notes:
CHANGES

Credits now cost 1 cent USD each.
Prices in the store have been updated to reflect new Credits value.
Credits are now awarded upon quest victory!

Bronze - 10 credits
Silver - 20 credits
Gold - 30 credits the first victory, and 10 credits each following victory
Territory - 100 credits
Once Only - 50 credits
Heroic - 100 credits the first victory, and 25 credits each following victory
